استمررن (form X)
# اِسْتَمْرَرْنَ (istamrarna) /is.tam.rar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
# اُسْتُمْرِرْنَ (ustumrirna) /us.tum.rir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
# اِسْتَمْرِرْنَ (istamrirna) /is.tam.rir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَمَرَّ (istamarra)
